messages:
olivia: Kicking off apples-to-apples run comparing rwi-13b-quant vs rwi-13b-quant-2. Same prompts, same decode params (temp=0.0, top_p=0.95), identical stop sequences. Tokenizer alignment check done.

bench-bot: queued run id=apples-2026-03-18-01, replay harness using recorded-prod-2026-02. Est. 75k requests, mix of short(<=32) and long(>512) seqs.

sam: Reminder - lock kernel selector to `kernel_profile=v2_int8` for both models. Last time the selector chose `sparse_mlp` on one variant and skewed perf.

jia: Observed a KV warmup regression on the first 30s of replays. p50 stable but p99 spikes when prefix hits cache-miss. Profiler excerpt:
```
CPU: 12% | GPU: 88%
top ops: attention_kv_copy (45%), matmul_qk (20%), kernel_dispatch (10%)
KV cache misses: 14.7% of calls in first 10k requests
```

olivia: Batch heuristic tweak: set `batching.window_ms=8` and `min_batch_size=2` for short-seq traffic. That recovered 18% throughput on synthetic uniform short seq test.

sam: Results snapshot (apples-2026-03-18-01):
- rwi-13b-quant: p50=48ms p95=110ms p99=210ms qps=120 (50-512 mix)
- rwi-13b-quant-2: p50=50ms p95=125ms p99=235ms qps=103
Note: kernel selector differed before lock; after lock numbers converged but quant-2 still higher p99 on long tails.

jia: Tokenizer alignment check: a sample prompt produced token counts: modelA=72 tokens, modelB=72 tokens. So tokenizer mismatch not the cause.

olivia: Action items:
- sam: run a 1h replay with kernel locked and KV pre-warm for first 5k requests (deadline EOD)
- jia: add a profiler hook to record KV hit-rate per request id
- bench-bot: schedule synthetic burst test (50->200 qps) with same seed

sam: ack. I'll also diff kernel dispatch logs to see if kernel choice changes mid-run. If we see kernel thrash that's likely causing jitter.

bench-bot: synthetic burst scheduled: id=burst-2026-03-18-01, seed=42, payloads attached.

olivia: thanks all. we'll reconvene after the 1h run. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
